```python
import requests

api_key = "RST495"          # <-- replace with your actual key
ip_address = "10.10.0.0"

url = f"https://www.virustotal.com/api/v3/ip_addresses/{ip_address}"
headers = {
    "x-apikey": api_key
}

response = requests.get(url, headers=headers)
print(response.json())
```
